name: Python 3
updateContentCommand: set -e; if [ -f packages.txt ]; then sudo apt-get update; sudo xargs -a packages.txt apt-get install -y; sudo apt-get clean; sudo rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*; fi; if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip3 install --user -r requirements.txt; fi; echo 'Packages installed and requirements met'
